sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the static requirement: both ship relationships are required and constrained by sh:equals to the same case node; the paired node has both required case classifications, requires the propulsion-line-strength purpose, and node-level prohibits the stalling-analysis purpose. Canonical namespaces, owners, paths, and deterministic validation are valid.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Do not model the ice-milling sequence and propulsion-line load case as independent ship links: the graph can currently satisfy them with two unrelated cases, causing an accidental pass. Constrain both relationships to the same load-case node, or add a canonical linking path that explicitly establishes that the ice-milling sequence is the propulsion-line strength-evaluation case; request that missing canonical pairing term/path. Preserve the positive strength-evaluation purpose and the negative stalling-analysis purpose constraint on that paired case.

The positive purpose check is correctly attached to the paired load-case node, but the negative stalling check is not faithfully encoded: sh:not contains a bare sh:hasValue constraint without its own sh:path, and it is nested on the loadCasePurpose property shape, where it may be evaluated against each purpose value rather than reliably prohibiting the stalling purpose on the case. Replace it with a valid node-level constraint on the paired case (for example, sh:not containing a property shape with sh:path nltl:loadCasePurpose and sh:hasValue nltl:stallingAnalysisPurposeValue), or use a bounded SPARQL check. Preserve the existing same-node pairing constraint and positive propulsion-line-strength purpose requirement.

The hasIceMillingSequenceCase property has canonical range nltl:iceMillingSequenceCase, but its nested node shape asserts sh:class nltl:loadCase instead. Add sh:class nltl:iceMillingSequenceCase (or otherwise faithfully constrain the linked case to its declared range), while preserving the existing sh:equals pairing with hasPropulsionLoadCase, the positive propulsionLineStrengthEvaluationPurpose value, and the node-level prohibition of stallingAnalysisPurposeValue.

The candidate faithfully encodes the static requirement: both ship relationships are required and constrained by sh:equals to the same case node; the paired node has both required case classifications, requires the propulsion-line-strength purpose, and node-level prohibits the stalling-analysis purpose. Canonical namespaces, owners, paths, and deterministic validation are valid.
